title: Migrate tests to xUnit v3 and Microsoft.Testing.Platform
api_or_output: Pinned xunit.v3.mtp-v2 4.0.1 and Microsoft.Testing.Platform test infrastructure

acceptance.description: Apply user-requested central PackageVersion xunit.v3.mtp-v2 4.0.1 and global.json test runner Microsoft.Testing.Platform; adapt all three test projects and remove superseded VSTest/xUnit v2 package references, retaining net10.0-only SDK pin.

Update owned CI workflow and reproducible bootstrap verifier for actual MTP invocation semantics. Clean restore/Release build/test discovery/test execution/pack and workflow-equivalent commands pass with actual xUnit v3 tests in all three test shells; test-runner failures propagate nonzero. Infrastructure smoke tests are reported separately from product conformance.

Preserve verified bootstrap/discovery/experiments, inspect actual transitive package/runner inventory, record exact commands and outcomes at known implementation revision, and pass task graph validation. Do not rewrite historical passing evidence.

implementation: Directory.Packages.props: sole test framework central pin xunit.v3.mtp-v2 4.0.1; global.json: Microsoft.Testing.Platform with unchanged 10.0.400 SDK pin.
tests/{Xemele.Tests,Xemele.Conformance.Tests,Xemele.Differential.Tests}/*.csproj: executable MTP test shells without VSTest/xUnit v2 references.
tests/{Xemele.Tests,Xemele.Conformance.Tests,Xemele.Differential.Tests}/Infrastructure/MtpRunnerSmokeTests.cs: Category=Infrastructure smoke assertion with controlled environment-triggered failure.
docs/reports/M0-tests-mtp/check_runner.py: per-project discovery, solution execution/TRX/XML, infrastructure/product count split, each project controlled assertion failure exit 2 validation.
.github/workflows/build.yml and docs/reports/M0-build/verify.py: shared native MTP runner verification; bootstrap writes new task artifacts and preserves historical evidence.
docs/reports/M0-tests-mtp/verify.py: clean generated outputs, bootstrap and workflow-equivalent validation, exact actual package inventory and dotnet-inspect metadata.

evidence.summary: Clean project bin/obj removal, pinned SDK 10.0.400 restore, Release build (0 warnings/errors), all three test apps discovery (1 infrastructure test each), solution execution (3 passed, 0 product tests), controlled assertion failures (each exit 2 with expected XML/message), 13 Python discovery tests, empty API/corpus discovery, 16 shell help/default invocations, 3 unknown-command exits 2, managed-only net10.0 runtime pack and API count 0, workflow-equivalent pack, actual inventories/package metadata inspection, and 97-task validation passed on macOS arm64. No hosted CI OS matrix run is claimed. Initial sandbox-only restore (NU1900 connectivity) and test help (IPC permission) failed; authorized unsandboxed full verification passed without suppressing checks.

handoff.summary: Implemented requested xUnit v3/MTP v2 migration on assigned isolated branch; awaiting coordinator integration verification. Infrastructure smoke tests are explicitly separate from product conformance.
